\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 166-169 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R174-first-pass-words-from-chapters-166-169}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a tyre and a brake.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a vulture, a whale, a crab, a snail, cricket
  \item a passenger, a taxi, a rickshaw, a motorbike, a lorry
  \item a mother-in-law, a bridegroom, a bride, a wedding, a relative
  \item joy, shame, fear, anger, peace
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A vulture? (\textbf{\bn{শকুন}}, \emph{shôkun}.) A whale? (\textbf{\bn{তিমি}}, \emph{timi}.) A crab? (\textbf{\bn{কাঁকড়া}}, \emph{kā̃kṛā}.) A snail? (\textbf{\bn{শামুক}}, \emph{shāmuk}.) Cricket? (\textbf{\bn{ক্রিকেট}}, \emph{krikeṭ}.) A passenger? (\textbf{\bn{যাত্রী}}, \emph{jātrī}.) A taxi? (\textbf{\bn{ট্যাক্সি}}, \emph{ṭæksi}.) A rickshaw? (\textbf{\bn{রিকশা}}, \emph{rikshā}.) A motorbike? (\textbf{\bn{মোটরসাইকেল}}, \emph{moṭôrsāikel}.) A lorry? (\textbf{\bn{ট্রাক}}, \emph{ṭrāk}.) A mother-in-law? (\textbf{\bn{শাশুড়ি}}, \emph{shāshuṛi}.) A bridegroom? (\textbf{\bn{বর}}, \emph{bôr}.) A bride? (\textbf{\bn{কনে}}, \emph{kône}.) A wedding? (\textbf{\bn{বিয়ে}}, \emph{biye}.) A relative? (\textbf{\bn{আত্মীয়}}, \emph{ātmīyô}.) Joy? (\textbf{\bn{আনন্দ}}, \emph{ānôndô}.) Shame? (\textbf{\bn{লজ্জা}}, \emph{lôjjā}.) Fear? (\textbf{\bn{ভয়}}, \emph{bhôy}.) Anger? (\textbf{\bn{রাগ}}, \emph{rāg}.) Peace? (\textbf{\bn{শান্তি}}, \emph{shānti}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 170-174 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R174-second-pass-words-from-chapters-170-174}



\begin{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a shape, a piece, a queue, a procession, a tap
  \item a bud, a rose, a banyan tree, paddy, high tide
  \item sports, a female student, a board, chalk, a scholarship
  \item a jalebi, a laddu, jaggery, a black plum, a lychee
  \item a plug, an engine, a wheel, a tyre, a brake

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A shape? (\textbf{\bn{আকার}}, \emph{ākār}.) A piece? (\textbf{\bn{টুকরো}}, \emph{ṭukro}.) A queue? (\textbf{\bn{লাইন}}, \emph{lāin}.) A procession? (\textbf{\bn{মিছিল}}, \emph{michhil}.) A tap? (\textbf{\bn{কল}}, \emph{kôl}.) A bud? (\textbf{\bn{কুঁড়ি}}, \emph{kũṛi}.) A rose? (\textbf{\bn{গোলাপ}}, \emph{golāp}.) A banyan tree? (\textbf{\bn{বট}}, \emph{bôṭ}.) Paddy? (\textbf{\bn{ধান}}, \emph{dhān}.) High tide? (\textbf{\bn{জোয়ার}}, \emph{joyār}.) Sports? (\textbf{\bn{খেলাধুলা}}, \emph{khelādhulā}.) A female student? (\textbf{\bn{ছাত্রী}}, \emph{chhātrī}.) A board? (\textbf{\bn{বোর্ড}}, \emph{borḍ}.) Chalk? (\textbf{\bn{চক}}, \emph{chôk}.) A scholarship? (\textbf{\bn{বৃত্তি}}, \emph{britti}.) A jalebi? (\textbf{\bn{জিলিপি}}, \emph{jilipi}.) A laddu? (\textbf{\bn{লাড্ডু}}, \emph{lāḍḍu}.) Jaggery? (\textbf{\bn{গুড়}}, \emph{guṛ}.) A black plum? (\textbf{\bn{জাম}}, \emph{jām}.) A lychee? (\textbf{\bn{লিচু}}, \emph{lichu}.) A plug? (\textbf{\bn{প্লাগ}}, \emph{plāg}.) An engine? (\textbf{\bn{ইঞ্জিন}}, \emph{injin}.) A wheel? (\textbf{\bn{চাকা}}, \emph{chākā}.) A tyre? (\textbf{\bn{টায়ার}}, \emph{ṭāyār}.) A brake? (\textbf{\bn{ব্রেক}}, \emph{brek}.)
